title: [Bug]: For TC bgp/test_seq_idf_isolation.py fixture traffic_shift_community is unavailable to the Test file for all the test cases.
author: vikshaw-Nokia
body:

The TC bgp/test_seq_idf_isolation.py has 4 test cases which are using the fixture traffic_shift_community  which is neither defined in the test file nor is imported from other test files.
